stage_scope: types, fake backend, validator, local trigger gate, fallback, safe diagnostics, Agent Shadow injection, and disabled/no-key/fake Development parity

shadow.exact_response_mismatch_note: All 649 paired raw response dicts contain independently measured retriever latency differences. After removing only latency_ms and stage_latencies_ms, behavior parity is exact for message, ask, recommendations, usage, state, Strategy, QueryPlan, retrieval route, candidates, and fallback diagnostics.

implemented_invariants: disabled, ineligible, no-key, input-bound, backend-error, and validator-error paths never apply a delta
each eligible session/turn makes at most one fake backend call and never retries, including duplicate respond calls
the guard returns by the request deadline; provider adapters must also enforce their transport timeout
validator is all-or-nothing and checks exact schema, token-bounded evidence spans, allowed attributes, bounded vocabulary, conflicts, state restoration rules, and finite non-negative telemetry
Agent records only safe aggregate Shadow diagnostics outside the public response
semantic proposal never mutates SessionState, Strategy, QueryPlan, clarification, retrieval request, recommendations, or response
local vocabulary is capped at 200 items

next_gate.reason: The authoritative protocol requires at least 60 independently sourced examples, two members' independent annotations, reconciliation, schema instructions, and a frozen file hash before the first real API run. No such gold fixture is claimed in this offline foundation stage. The first provider adapter must also add malformed, empty, truncated and injected JSON fixtures plus DNS, HTTP 401/403/429/5xx, transport-timeout, and secret-redaction tests before any remote run.
